name: Domes Zeen Chania
insider_take: This adults-only sanctuary perches dramatically on Crete's rugged coastline, where contemporary Greek elegance meets the wild beauty of the Aegean Sea.
whats_special: Domes Zeen Chania occupies a stunning clifftop location near the historic Venetian harbor town of Chania, one of Greece's most photogenic destinations. The property features infinity pools that appear to merge with the Mediterranean horizon, while the nearby Balos Lagoon—consistently ranked among the world's most beautiful beaches—creates a pink-sand paradise just a boat ride away.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the hotel's cliffside restaurant during the "golden hour" when the sun sets directly over the sea, creating Instagram-worthy photos that capture Crete's legendary light.
dont_miss: Explore Chania's enchanting Old Town with its maze of Venetian and Ottoman architecture, then venture to the ancient Minoan palace of Knossos—Europe's oldest city. The hotel's proximity to Stavros Beach, where "Zorba the Greek" was filmed, offers a perfect blend of cinematic history and crystal-clear waters.
pros: Prime beachfront location on stunning Crete coastline
Contemporary luxury design with authentic Greek hospitality
Multiple dining venues featuring Mediterranean cuisine
